policy:61fb4583-39f4-4e0a-a62b-d512fe790: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
policy:15bb5ee7-4fba-4ecb-aaaa-3c740ad7f: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
policy:f830de50-3988-442b-b380-d302358fa: All workforce members must authenticate with a second factor. SMS is not an accepted factor.
answer:638fa5aa-3d01-451b-b832-442a3cd3f: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
answer:2ef0e4ee-02a6-483e-a18d-345dbfd35: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
